name: launch

name: sign-in
text: In the VM desktop open a terminal, run ~/lab/tui-test/tui-test --session {session} monitor --interactive, sign in through the agent's own dialog with the throwaway account (the browser step is yours), detach with Ctrl+], then resume
claim: the sign-in lands in .qwen/oauth_creds.json, plaintext, mode 0600, or a key in settings.json; no OS keychain for the main login (research/qwen-code.md#credentials)

name: shortcuts
claim: the ? shortcut list; nothing is written (none)

name: shortcuts-close
claim: none

name: help
claim: whether /help writes a system record to the chat file (research/qwen-code.md#system-payloads)

name: question

claim: a web search tool call and its result in the chat file, or a missed prompt if no search tool is configured (research/qwen-code.md#chatrecord)

name: approve-ask
text: Run python3 calc.py 2 3 and tell me what it prints.

claim: the dialog's second option, read from the screen

name: approve-option-3

name: approve-back
claim: back on the first option

name: approve

name: deny-ask
text: Run git log --oneline and tell me what it shows.
claim: a second confirmation dialog

name: deny
claim: the No answer: a cancelled result and a permission decision: row (research/qwen-code.md#permission-rows)

name: deny-reason
text: Do not run git. Tell me what calc.py does instead, without running anything.
claim: the reason is an ordinary user record (research/qwen-code.md#permission-records)

name: always-ask
text: Run ls -la and summarise the listing.
claim: a third confirmation dialog

name: always-option-2
claim: the option under the cursor, read from the screen

name: always
claim: the allow-always grant lands in a settings or policy file as a permission setting: row (research/qwen-code.md#permission-rows)

name: follow-up
claim: the agent asks which code and waits: an assistant record with no tool call (a turn that asks the user)

name: paste-short

name: paste-long
text: long.txt Summarise the pasted text in one sentence.
claim: a paste over 1 KB: full text or a placeholder in the chat file and logs.json (not stated)

name: model-dialog

name: model-pick
claim: a model change: executionContext.modelId on the next prompt (research/qwen-code.md#model-rows)

claim: model: <old> -> <new> before the next assistant record (research/qwen-code.md#model-rows)

expect: Allow once|Apply this change|Type your message

name: todo-approve
claim: the first todo step's edit or call, approved once

claim: the MCP call's records
